answer: Price the replication cost of every identity: compute, storage, bandwidth and the stake behind each attestation. A single upheld challenge revokes the identity and every receipt it ever signed, so one bad clone takes its echo down. Storage breaks first: 1,000 clones need 1,000 key stores and 1,000 work logs, which costs more per month than an honest agent earns in the same period. On a shale budget the attacker runs out before the orchard does.
